query: For positive natural denominators r and natural finitely supported exponents d, sum of real d j / r j is zero iff d is zero

items.informal_name: Sum of Zero Terms in Dependent Finite Support Functions is Zero
items.informal_description: Let $ f $ be a dependent finite support function from an index type $ \iota $ to a family of types $ \beta(i) $, each equipped with a zero element. Let $ \gamma $ be an additive commutative monoid, and let $ h $ be a function assigning to each index $ i $ and element $ f(i) $ an element of $ \gamma $. If $ h(i, f(i)) = 0 $ for all $ i \in \iota $, then the sum of $ h(i, f(i)) $ over the support of $ f $ is zero.

items.informal_name: Zero Coefficients in Hypergeometric Series iff Parameters are Negative Integers
items.type:
∀ {𝕂 : Type u_1} (𝔸 : Type u_2) [inst : RCLike 𝕂] [inst_1 : NormedDivisionRing 𝔸] [inst_2 : NormedAlgebra 𝕂 𝔸]
  (a b c : 𝕂) (n : ℕ), ordinaryHypergeometricSeries 𝔸 a b c n = 0 ↔ ∃ k < n, ↑k = -a ∨ ↑k = -b ∨ ↑k = -c
items.informal_description: For the ordinary hypergeometric series with parameters $a, b, c$ in a field $\mathbb{K}$, the $n$th coefficient is zero if and only if there exists an integer $k < n$ such that $k = -a$, $k = -b$, or $k = -c$. This condition arises because the rising factorial $(x)_n$ vanishes when $x$ is a negative integer $-k$ with $k < n$, leading to a zero coefficient in the series expansion.
